__doc__: The roadmap catalog: goals, each an ordered list of steps made of this bridge's own tools. It says WHICH calls a step is made of and why, and nothing about whether they work: mif_roadmap derives that per engine, project and editor at call time (mif_roadmap_ground.py; docs/30_ROADMAP.md). A step is made of tools, or is `manual` with why the bridge cannot do it and what to do instead. A `check` is a read-only call that says the step is already done in the project; its endpoint must be on mif_roadmap_ground.CHECK_ENDPOINTS and its params are the endpoint's own (camelCase). tools/test_mif_roadmap.py checks every tool, check endpoint and check parameter named here.

blender_prop.title: A prop modelled in Blender, with collision, measured for a game engine

steps.say: Blender answers, which version, and whether the add-on is the one this server expects.
Model it from primitives and edits - rounded edges catch the light.
Make it game-ready and measure it: transforms, a UV layer, and the mesh quality checks.
Convex collision hulls named for Unreal's UCX_ convention.
